class.name: EditorScenePostImportPlugin
class.brief_description: Plugin to control and modifying the process of importing a scene.
class.description: This plugin type exists to modify the process of importing scenes, allowing to change the content as well as add importer options at every stage of the process.

method.name: _get_import_options
method.description: Override to add general import options. These will appear in the main import dock on the editor. Add options via [method add_import_option] and [method add_import_option_advanced].

method.name: _get_internal_import_options
method.description: Override to add internal import options. These will appear in the 3D scene import dialog. Add options via [method add_import_option] and [method add_import_option_advanced].

method.name: _get_internal_option_update_view_required
method.description: Should return [code]true[/code] if the 3D view of the import dialog needs to update when changing the given option.

method.name: _get_internal_option_visibility
method.description: Should return [code]true[/code] to show the given option, [code]false[/code] to hide the given option, or [code]null[/code] to ignore.

method.name: _get_option_visibility
method.description: Should return [code]true[/code] to show the given option, [code]false[/code] to hide the given option, or [code]null[/code] to ignore.

method.name: _internal_process
method.description: Process a specific node or resource for a given category.

method.name: _post_process
method.description: Post-process the scene. This function is called after the final scene has been configured.

method.name: _pre_process
method.description: Pre-process the scene. This function is called right after the scene format loader loaded the scene and no changes have been made. Pre-process may be used to adjust internal import options in the [code]"nodes"[/code], [code]"meshes"[/code], [code]"animations"[/code] or [code]"materials"[/code] keys inside [code]get_option_value("_subresources")[/code].

method.name: add_import_option
method.description: Add a specific import option (name and default value only). This function can only be called from [method _get_import_options] and [method _get_internal_import_options].

method.name: add_generated_file
method.description: Records a sidecar file that this plugin wrote into the importer's generated-file list, which is stored as [code]dest_files[/code] in the scene's [code].import[/code] file. Can only be called from [method _post_process]. What this does: the path is listed among the files this import produced, so tooling that reads [code].import[/code] can see it, and a later reimport that no longer registers it drops it from the list. What this does [b]not[/b] do, despite what the list is often assumed to give you: - It does not delete the file. An ordinary [code]res://[/code] sidecar is not removed on reimport just because it stopped being registered; the plugin owns its own cleanup. - It does not create a resource dependency. Nothing loads the file because it is listed here. - It does not put the file in an export. For that, the saved scene or one of its resources has to actually reference the sidecar, or an export filter has to include it. [param path] must be a canonical [code]res://[/code] path inside the project. Relative paths, [code]user://[/code], [code]uid://[/code] aliases, paths under [code]res://.godot/[/code] and the imported scene's own source file are all rejected. Registering a path that another plugin already registered during the same import is also an error rather than a silent overwrite. [b]Note:[/b] [method _post_process] runs after the lightmap unwrap and LOD generation have reworked the per-node meshes, which the per-category hooks such as [constant INTERNAL_IMPORT_CATEGORY_MESH] do not. It is not a general "meshes are final" phase: a plugin that runs later can still modify them, and steps such as single-mesh merging happen after all plugins have run.

method.name: add_import_option_advanced
method.description: Add a specific import option. This function can only be called from [method _get_import_options] and [method _get_internal_import_options].

method.name: get_option_value
method.description: Query the value of an option. This function can only be called from those querying visibility, or processing.
